reference_policy.use: offline precision contract or sanitized non-identifying control board only

composition_control.measurement_subject: container body and its verified components

capture_signature.lens: reference-specific 38-68mm-equivalent rectilinear optics at a disciplined working distance
capture_signature.depth: whole product resolved with optical depth created by plane geometry, scale and light falloff
capture_signature.exposure: manual-style exposure placement using the selected highlight, midtone and black-point contract
capture_signature.rendering: professional art-directed editorial lifestyle photography with restrained naturalism
capture_signature.framing: reference-specific subject scale, negative-space topology and support-plane perspective
capture_signature.optics: reference-specific rectilinear lens geometry with controlled edge distortion and disciplined working distance
capture_signature.finish: quiet premium material rendering, deliberate tonal separation and no generic stock-photo polish

spatial_depth.scene_geometry: Establish depth through support-plane convergence, overlap, diminishing scale and light falloff.
spatial_depth.focus_behavior: Keep the exact product resolved; reduce only far-plane microcontrast when physically distant.
spatial_depth.subject_sharpness: complete product, rim, contents and verified branding

hard_fail: camera geometry does not match the selected photographic style contract
support-plane perspective or negative-space topology differs materially from the contract
output reads as a casual smartphone snapshot or generic cafe stock photo
color separation or tonal curve loses the selected reference character
lighting screen map, shadow vector or highlight behavior contradicts the contract
changed beverage category or product material

retry_policy.composition_failure: recompile the exact camera and support-plane geometry before any retry
retry_policy.style_failure: do not add aesthetic adjectives; restore the photographic style contract and sanitized control board
retry_policy.identity_failure: route to the separate identity or brand restoration workflow

identity_repair.trigger: protected identity fails while photographic style passes
identity_repair.instruction: preserve the approved editorial scene and correct only failed product identity details
